Headline results for run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (stride 20, read-only report):

RECORDS ANALYSED: 759 records (2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z, 3.314% of the time window).

ANOMALIES / DETECTIONS: 57 anomalous records (|robust z| > 5); 62 DAS detections in 53 records, with relative b = 0.9849 (34 detections above the catalogue magnitude of completeness Mc).

PUMPING CONTEXT: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days.

CATALOGUE: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07 (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016).

CALIBRATED (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5 — LBNL catalogue magnitudes; this is the calibrated probability):
  b      Sigma      P(M>=5.5)/yr   P(M>=5.5) over observed volume   P(M>=3)/yr
  1.0    -5.449     0.0001198      5.236e-06                       0.03719
  0.73   -5.319     0.004922       0.0002155                       0.2809
  0.65   -5.281     0.01474        0.0006484                       0.4653

UPPER BOUND (DAS-based, uncalibrated magnitudes; every detection counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts — this is NOT calibrated):
  b 0.9849, Sigma -2.698, P(M>=5.5)/yr 0.07842

Interpretation: the calibrated LBNL-catalogue probabilities of a Pohang-like Mw>=5.5 event are very low (1.2e-4 to 1.5e-2 per year depending on the b scenario), while the DAS-based upper bound (7.8e-2 per year) is higher because uncalibrated DAS magnitudes over-count detections as events.
